client: confidential

start: 2022-01
end: 2022-03

stack:

  steps.
metrics:

text: Mina did solid work on our subscription churn project and was easy to work with on an hourly basis. She built monthly retention curves by signup cohort and plan, plus a funnel of onboarding steps, which gave us a clearer view of where users were dropping off. One of the onboarding steps she surfaced was linked to 40% of first-month churn, which was very useful for our team.
